The conversion failed significantly regarding URL extraction. First, a URL belonging to a footnote on page 78 ('https://lnmc.org/list-of-charter-boats-approved-by-lake-norman-marine-commission/') was incorrectly mapped to the word 'Commission' in the Roll Call section on page 1. More critically, the pipeline interpreted numeric monetary values in Land Acquisition summaries (Exhibits D-1 and D-2) as domain names and fabricated malformed URLs for them. For example, '$2,100,000.00' was converted into a link with the href 'https://2,100,000.00'. These URLs do not exist in the source text or annotations.
